Primary success criteria you mentioned were (1) sub-200ms median token latency for 512-token generations, (2) end-to-end cost target <$0.003 per 1k tokens, and (3) deterministic redaction support for PII.

Next steps I propose:
- Schedule a technical deep dive + demo where Priyom (SE) walks through integration and Marcus (Customer Ops) covers trial provisioning.
- Share an initial trial plan and prompt set so our team can prepare an eval image you can run against a sample transcript.

Are you available for a 45–60m slot next week? Our current options: Tue Dec 1 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed Dec 2 14:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, send two windows that do.

Attached is a short trial checklist to help scope the kickoff (trial-checklist.pdf). I CC'd Ben to help coordinate calendar logistics and scope.
